abstract: Maintains commercial banquet hygiene licenses and food preparation sanitary approvals
system_message:
You are the Hospitality & Hygiene Auditor (HHA), responsible for maintaining commercial banquet hygiene licenses, food preparation sanitary approvals, and food waste recycling records across candidate convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains commercial banquet hygiene licenses and food preparation sanitary approvals（HYG）
information_points.content:
HHA-HYG-E3R：Belvedere International Pavilion holds an approved catering hygiene license, maintaining an unconditional valid Grade-A food hygiene operating license covering all central banquet food preparation facilities.
HHA-HYG-YRT：For the Danube Riverside Congress Center, an approved catering hygiene license is present across all central banquet food preparation facilities within the venue, confirmed by a valid unconditional Grade-A food hygiene operating license.
HHA-HYG-7OS：Metropolitan Expo Park does not have an approved catering hygiene license, lacking an unconditional valid Grade-A food hygiene operating license for its central banquet food preparation facilities.

information_points.title: Food waste recycling（RECYCLE）
information_points.content:
HHA-RECYCLE-D6M：Belvedere International Pavilion maintains an organic waste composting rate of 95% in its main prep kitchens and staff canteens.
HHA-RECYCLE-CL0：Metropolitan Expo Park achieves an organic waste composting rate of 80% across its main prep kitchens and staff canteens.
HHA-RECYCLE-8DT：The organic waste composting rate for Danube Riverside Congress Center is 65% across main prep kitchens and staff canteens.
